errors.ITEM_UNIT_LOCKED: This item has stock history, so its unit cannot change. Create a new item instead.
errors.ITEM_NAME_EXISTS: An item with this name already exists
errors.ITEM_HAS_STOCK: This item still has stock. Issue it first
errors.WAREHOUSE_HAS_STOCK: This warehouse still holds stock. Move it out first
errors.INVALID_QUANTITY: Quantity must be greater than zero
errors.BATCH_ALREADY_USED: This batch has been used, so the receipt cannot be reversed
errors.AVERAGE_COST_USED: Stock issued after this receipt was priced on an average that includes it, so the receipt cannot be reversed
errors.DOCUMENT_HAS_PAYMENT: This receipt has a payment. Cancel it in finance first
errors.DOCUMENT_NOT_REVERSIBLE: This document cannot be reversed here
errors.DOCUMENT_NUMBER_AMBIGUOUS: Two documents share this number, so it cannot be reversed by number
errors.COUNT_NOT_DRAFT: This stock count is already approved
errors.COUNT_EMPTY: Add at least one item to the count
errors.COUNT_ALREADY_OPEN: {{item}} is already on open count sheet {{docNo}}. Approve or delete that sheet first
errors.COUNT_BOOK_MOVED: Stock moved while this count was being approved. Approve it again

receipt.title: Receive stock
receipt.description: Enter a purchase, an opening balance or a return.
receipt.pendingApproval: The payment is waiting for approval
receipt.supplierAddHere: Not on the list. Add one with the button under this field.
receipt.supplierAskFinance: Not on the list. The accountant adds suppliers under Finance, Counterparties.
receipt.payNowHint: The cost reaches a cost center when stock is issued
receipt.financeRecords: The accountant records the payment or debt for this receipt.
receipt.categoryHint: Some items here have no category of their own. This one is used for the whole receipt.

issue.title: Issue stock
issue.description: Hand out stock: its cost is charged to the chosen cost center.
issue.costCenterHint: A field, herd, machine or the whole farm

transfer.title: Transfer between warehouses
transfer.description: Stock moves to another warehouse and keeps its cost.

stock.title: Stock balances
stock.description: What is in each warehouse and how much, with batches and expiry dates.
stock.emptyBody: Add the first receipt: feed, seed, drugs or fuel.

low.emptyBody: Every item is above its minimum.

expiring.emptyBody: No batch expires in the selected period.

items.title: Items
items.description: Feed, seed, fertilizer, drugs, fuel, spare parts and finished goods.
items.emptyBody: Add the items you keep track of in stock.
items.deleteBody: "{{name}}" leaves the list. Old documents keep it.

fields.name: Name
fields.minQtyHint: You get a warning below this
fields.kgPerUnitHint: For example, kg per bale. Rations need it
fields.cropHint: Turns a shortage into hectares to sow
fields.withdrawalDaysHint: Days after treatment before meat can be sold
fields.transferPriceHint: Price for moving own produce to stock and livestock, per {{unit}}

fertiliser.title: Fertiliser content
fertiliser.hint: Percent of the active nutrient, as printed on the bag. Leave a field empty if you do not know it: the fertiliser rate on the field card then leaves this product out.

nutrients.title: Nutrient content
nutrients.hint: All figures are for 1 kg of dry matter. Leave a field empty if you do not know it: the ration balance then names it as missing and does not guess.
nutrients.typicalHint: Typical values, not measured: table averages from Feedipedia (INRAE, CIRAD, AFZ, FAO). Your feed may differ.
nutrients.typicalApplied: Typical values for "{{feed}}" are filled in. They are table averages, not an analysis of your feed: correct them when you have a laboratory result.
nutrients.feedClassHint: The least-cost mix keeps a share of roughage

warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.description: The farm's warehouses and how many items each holds.
warehouses.emptyBody: Create at least one warehouse before receiving stock.
warehouses.deleteBody: "{{name}}" leaves the list. Old documents keep it.

movements.title: Movements
movements.description: Every receipt, issue, transfer and correction: who, when and how much.
movements.author: Entered by
movements.reverseBody: Every line of the document is undone and stock returns to what it was.

counts.title: Stock counts
counts.description: Count what is really there, compare it with the books and record the difference.
counts.addHint: The sheet lists everything in the chosen warehouse.
counts.emptyBody: Start a count: the book quantities fill in by themselves.
counts.noLinesBody: This warehouse has no stock. Add an item below.
counts.addItemPlaceholder: Choose an item that is not listed
counts.approveBody: Items with a difference: {{count}}. Approving sets stock to these counts and cannot be undone.
counts.deleteBody: Anything entered on the sheet is lost.
